run_opt_stats: run opt-stats.py to generate statistics about LLVM optimization records from YAML files
find_opt_files: find all *.opt.yaml optimization record files in a directory or file list
gather_results: gather optimization remarks from multiple YAML files using parallel processing
test_find_opt_files: test the find_opt_files function to discover optimization record YAML files
summarize_remarks: summarize top 10 optimization remarks by pass name and full pass/name combination
